label: A distinct esse CAUSE_2 of a thing is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it
paraphrase: For any c and x, if c is distinct from x and c causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, the cause-of-perfection relation at esse), then c is simply prior to x. It is the instance of efficient-cause priority that the stage-two composition and component routes use, restricted to distinct causes and to esse, and stated for the cause-of-perfection relation rather than for efficient causing. It says nothing about self-causes or other respects, so it does not give STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-IS-PRIOR-TO-EFFECT (Control.NotEfficientPriority).
